title: Cancel a shipment
body:
Support needs to cancel shipments.

Add `cancel_shipment(shipment_id, reason)` to `parcelo/shipments.py`. It sets the shipment status to "cancelled", appends the reason to the shipment's notes, and returns the shipment.

Cancelling a shipment that does not exist must fail. Cancelling one that is already cancelled or delivered must fail too.
